chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Abi Jamilah, from Abi Usamah, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the takbir in the two Eids. He said: seven and five. And he said: the salat of the two Eids is an obligation.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the pronouncement of Allahu Akbar within the Eid prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eids, Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
key_terms.خَمْسٌ: five, referring to the number of takbirs in the other unit
key_terms.سَبْعٌ: seven, referring to the number of takbirs in one unit
key_terms.فَرِيضَةٌ: a binding obligation in religious law

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are there in the Eid prayer, and is salat al-'idayn obligatory?
ai.summary: This hadith states the number of takbirs in the salat of the two Eids as seven and five. It also explicitly affirms that salat al-'idayn is fard, showing its binding legal status in Shia fiqh.
